turns.speaker: WILL
turns.utterance_text: Did Bartholomew show you the new house?

turns.speaker: AGNES
turns.utterance_text: Why didn't you show me yourself? Were you afraid I wouldn't leave? 'Cause Hamnet died here in this house.

turns.speaker: WILL
turns.utterance_text: You know, I'm constantly wondering where he is. Or where he has gone. Whatever I'm doing, I'm wondering, "Where is he?" I mean, he can't have just vanished. All he needs is for me to find him. He must be somewhere. I fear I may run mad with it, even now, a year on.

turns.speaker: AGNES
turns.utterance_text: A year is nothing. It's every second... every minute, every day. We may never stop looking for him.

turns.speaker: AGNES
turns.utterance_text: For what? You're caught by that place.

turns.speaker: AGNES
turns.utterance_text: That place in your head. It is now more real to you than anywhere else. Not even the death of our child can keep you from it. Hamnet died. A horrible death. And you should have been there. You could have bid him farewell.
